details: The cryptocurrency market is in a state of fragile equilibrium, with Bitcoin largely consolidating between $62,500 and $63,800. Investor sentiment is pressured by the fifth day of the Coldcard hardware wallet exploit, which has resulted in an estimated theft of 1,367 BTC (over $88 million) due to a vulnerability in older firmware. Additionally, the U.S. "CLARITY Act," aimed at digital asset regulation, faces significant delays, with its chances of passing in 2026 dropping to around 30%. If the bill fails, regulators may accelerate their own rulemaking, adding to market uncertainty.
title: Bitcoin Trades Sideways Amid Coldcard Hack & CLARITY Act Delays

details: MicroStrategy sold 1,638 Bitcoin for approximately $104.7 million between July 27 and August 2, 2026, while repurchasing $81.2 million of its preferred stock. Despite the sale and a nearly 40% year-to-date stock decline, CEO Phong Le expressed confidence that MicroStrategy will continue to actively manage its capital structure and outperform Bitcoin during the next bull run, viewing the current period as a "bear cycle."
title: MicroStrategy Sells BTC Amid Bear Cycle, CEO Remains Bullish

details: Ripple has further expanded its digital capital markets strategy by investing in Zilo and Lucuido, two UK-based firms. These companies are developing infrastructure for tokenized funds and institutional asset trading, aiming to integrate regulated fund issuance, settlement, and collateral mobility onto the XRP Ledger. This move builds on Ripple's existing partnerships and supports its broader institutional platform for tokenization, payments, stablecoins, and trading.
title: Ripple Invests in Tokenized Fund Infrastructure Firms

details: Binance will delist six crypto tokens – Across Protocol (ACX), Hashflow (HFT), PIVX, Vulcan Forged PYR (PYR), Vanar (VANRY), and Viction (VIC) – from its spot market on August 17 at 03:00 UTC. The delisting is a result of Binance's periodic asset review, which considers factors such as liquidity, development team activity, network security, and regulatory compliance. All associated spot trading pairs will be removed, and open orders canceled.
title: Binance to Delist Six Tokens in August Review

details: Bitmine Immersion Technologies announced that its Ethereum (ETH) holdings have reached 5.8 million tokens, representing 4.8% of the total ETH supply, with total crypto and cash holdings valued at $11.3 billion as of August 2, 2026. This significant accumulation follows a July where ETH outperformed the Nasdaq 100 by 2,500 basis points, the largest since July 2025, signaling strengthening fundamentals for the cryptocurrency.
title: Bitmine's ETH Holdings Soar to 4.8% of Total Supply

details: Cardano has successfully completed a significant hard fork and unveiled a new development roadmap. The upgrade aims to enhance transaction efficiency and expand support for a wider range of on-chain applications. This positive development has already led to a nearly twofold increase in trading volume for ADA and an intraday price surge of over 8%.
title: Cardano Hard Fork Improves Efficiency, Boosts ADA Trading

details: Decentralized exchange Uniswap has launched new "Earn" yield features, providing users with options for self-custody lending and generating yield on their USDC, USDT, and ETH holdings. This development enhances the DeFi platform's offerings and provides more opportunities for users to earn passive income within the ecosystem.
title: Uniswap Introduces New Earn Features for USDC, USDT, ETH

details: Zcash has announced a significant expansion of its real-world utility, allowing ZEC to be used for real estate purchases through TEKCE. This adoption covers Spain, Türkiye, the UAE, Northern Cyprus, and Sweden, providing ZEC with a high-ticket, privacy-oriented commerce use case. The news highlights a broader pattern of modest altcoin rotation and growing adoption for specific privacy-focused cryptocurrencies.
title: Zcash Now Usable for Real Estate Purchases in Multiple Countries
